tools.provenance: https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project release llvmorg-22.1.8 (2026-06-16), assets LLVM-22.1.8-Linux-X64 / Linux-ARM64 / macOS-ARM64 .tar.xz and clang+llvm-22.1.8-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.tar.xz; sha256 as published by the GitHub release asset digests. One clang compiles for ARM, AArch64, x86-64 and PowerPC (`--target=`), so the non-matching scaffolds (3DS, Switch, PS3, PS4, Vita, Xbox 360) use it to check that their decompiled C compiles. The archive holds a single top-level directory; the compiler is `<that directory>/bin/clang` (`bin/clang.exe` on Windows).
